result.instructions: Tools for Rasayel, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which conversations are still open, and who is assigned to each one?"; "List the contacts who wrote to us most recently."; "Send 'Your order has shipped' to the customer in conversation 12345.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Rasayel data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run rasayel_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run rasayel_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run rasayel_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. rasayel_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: rasayel_get_app
tools.title: Get Rasayel app
tools.description: Return the Rasayel app that the API key belongs to (id, name, company domain). Use it to confirm which workspace is connected. GraphQL: app.

tools.name: rasayel_list_conversations
tools.title: List conversations
tools.description: List conversations of the app with state, channel type, the contact and the assignee. Use pageInfo.endCursor as 'after' for the next page. GraphQL: app.conversations.

first.description: Page size (number of items to return).

after.description: Cursor: pass pageInfo.endCursor from the previous page to get the next page.

tools.name: rasayel_get_conversation
tools.title: Get conversation
tools.description: Return one conversation by id: state, channel type, the contact, the assignee and the last message summary. GraphQL: app.conversation(id).

id.description: Numeric Rasayel id, as a string.

tools.name: rasayel_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List channel users (customer contacts) of the app with name, username, blocked flag and creation time. Use pageInfo.endCursor as 'after' for the next page. GraphQL: app.channelUsers.

first.description: Page size (number of items to return).

after.description: Cursor: pass pageInfo.endCursor from the previous page to get the next page.

tools.name: rasayel_list_teammates
tools.title: List teammates
tools.description: List the app users (teammates) with id, name, email, status and presence. Their ids are the appUserId for rasayel_send_text_message. GraphQL: app.appUsers.

first.description: Page size (number of items to return).

after.description: Cursor: pass pageInfo.endCursor from the previous page to get the next page.

tools.name: rasayel_send_text_message
tools.title: Send text message
tools.description: Send a text message to the customer of a conversation. The customer receives it when Rasayel accepts it. Body is Markdown. Use rasayel_get_conversation first to confirm the conversation. GraphQL: mutation textMessageCreate.

appUserId.description: Teammate (app user) id to act as, sent as X-On-Behalf-Of. Get ids from rasayel_list_teammates.
